body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 51b3940ddb801d9b5fdcc033bbf332c7d2861e4a -->
Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review: this PR changes posted G-code.

The local trial merge with upstream/main `ad03386ea6f938f3f35bb102303b7a4c78c13849` was clean. I used that main's AGENTS.md for the law checks. No GitHub runner was used.

What looks good:
- The parser, parsed-machine checks, post mirror and post all carry the new value.
- The MCP edit uses the existing undoable machine patch. Its six tests passed.
- I checked the new golden line by line against `wire_slug_punch_passes.nc`. Only the stated header changes, T84 after T91, and T85 before C002 and C903 differ. No existing golden changed.

Results on the local merged tree:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 664 steps; 663 passed and one failed. Test totals: 6,034 passed, seven failed, 50 ignored.
- All selected post and app suites passed. These include the post library (78 tests), app library (390 passed, one ignored), `sodick_skim_flushing` (six), and all three Sodick app suites.
- UI library: 1,269 passed, seven failed, seven ignored. All seven failures report that this machine has no graphics adapter. They are six `egui_app::report_tests` tests and `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. The selected UI integration suites passed.

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

- I ran the changed UI test again from `crates/ui`: `the_wire_machine_editor_states_the_skim_flushing_only_with_a_flushing` passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The cache did not answer the first build. The completed checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

Extra suites run:
- I searched for readers of the changed Sodick golden directory, including paths built with formatting.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test conformance --test sodick_wire_dielectric --test sodick_wire_passes --test sodick_wire_post`: passed; seven, three, five and eight tests, respectively.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The extra kernel importer suites do not apply.

Mutations I ran:
1. Replace `sodick-wire.cps` and `wire-iso.cps` with upstream/main's versions. RED: five of six post tests and two of five app pass tests failed. Restore the scripts: GREEN, six post tests and five app pass tests passed.
2. Remove the `parse_skim_flushing` guard that requires `edm.flushing`. RED: `a_skim_flushing_parses_with_the_rough_flushing_and_is_refused_without_it` failed at the refusal assertion. Restore the guard: GREEN, that test passed.

All mutation edits were restored. No review evidence was committed or pushed.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_edm.rs:132`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the new Skim flushing control. The body says that no screenshot was made. Include the enabled and disabled states. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.
2. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sodick-wire/wire_slug_punch_passes_flushed.nc:1`: Supply the required heavy-lane results for the final head. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects `app heavy: every target` because this is shared test input. Current upstream AGENTS.md, “Heavy lanes at review,” requires the reached lanes before readiness. The body says that the heavy lanes were not run. I checked the plan but did not run those release lanes. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` and record the results in the body. Not run is not a pass.

Notes, not additional findings:
- The seven graphics failures limit local UI verification. The changed machine-editor test passes. I do not count the missing adapter as a code defect in this PR.
- `crates/post/tests/sodick_skim_flushing.rs:5` attributes the position before the C word to the manual. The decision file says this position is inferred. Align that provenance description with the decision.
- No output was tested on a Sodick control. Pixel snapshots were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Added before/after captures of the affected machine-editor controls to the PR body. The after captures show enabled and disabled Skim flushing. The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `632ada1a5abc9279ae867ca0a0bf8885c9dc1034`. The captures render the actual egui section with a CPU renderer. The existing pin `the_wire_machine_editor_states_the_skim_flushing_only_with_a_flushing` passed.
2. Ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. GREEN: 184 steps, zero failed steps, 24.2 minutes. There were 42 passing tests and one expected failure in the explicit `known_fail_1950` lane. The PR body records these results.

Head: `51b3940ddb801d9b5fdcc033bbf332c7d2861e4a` (unchanged). No source fix or new mutation check applies to these evidence findings. The plain push reports that the branch is up to date.

Clippy passed for post, app and UI, with all targets and warnings denied. Quick: 663 of 664 steps passed. Its seven failed tests report no graphics adapter, as in the review. All selected post, app and UI integration suites passed.

The initial base was `06d349391ca27e193a943fb37c51380e2c283f95`. Another process advanced the shared `upstream/main` ref during verification. The PR body records this limitation. No check ran on a merge with the newer main.

Please re-review these two findings. The PR remains a draft. No review label changed.
